about: Where pieces stood by default before the room was spread out, each time it was (2026-10-26, and the 8 x 6 m room of 2026-10-28). A layout saved every piece once it settled, moved or not, so a saved spot that is one of these was never chosen by anyone. FloorImport forgets them once; a piece somebody did move keeps its place. Frozen: the probes in tests/fixtures/layouts/control_room_legacy.json pin what it answers.
